100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 1, 1926, tensions escalated in the Middle East as violence erupted in Palestine amidst growing unrest between Jewish and Arab communities. In the United States, the National Football League announced plans to expand, signaling a burgeoning interest in professional sports. Meanwhile, the film industry continued to evolve, with silent films facing competition from the emerging talkies, reshaping Hollywood's landscape.
